messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: You should not use trazodone if you are allergic to it, or if you are being treated with methylene blue injection.
Do not use this medicine if you have taken an MAO inhibitor in the past 14 days. A dangerous drug interaction could occur. MAO inhibitors include isocarboxazid, linezolid, phenelzine, tranylcypromine and others.
Some young people have thoughts about suicide when first taking an antidepressant. Your doctor will need to check your progress at regular visits while you are using trazodone. Your family or other caregivers should also be alert to changes in your mood or symptoms.
Report any new or worsening symptoms to your doctor, such as: mood or behavior changes, anxiety, panic attacks, trouble sleeping, or if you feel impulsive, irritable, agitated, hostile, aggressive, restless, hyperactive (mentally or physically), more depressed, or have thoughts about suicide or hurting yourself.
Do not give this medicine to anyone younger than 18 years old without the advice of a doctor. Trazodone is not approved for use in children.
Triplet: ["Trazodone", "has drug interaction warning", "MAO inhibitors"]

The relation 'has drug interaction warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may interact dangerously with the substance or class of drugs specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
